messages.text: Thank you for the quick response

Hello Nick,

Glad that helped, and happy mining with the QX1.

One last thing worth doing before you flash: check which Harlo OS version the unit is showing now, and compare it against the latest QX1 release on harlolabs.com. That site has the downloads, release notes and install guides, and an older build is the most common cause of odd readings or missing features after an update.

If you want a second pair of eyes while you do it, our Discord is the fastest place for firmware questions. JD, our hardware guy, is in there as @nullhashrate and the Harlo OS channel is active. Here is the invite: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Any other questions, just reply here.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy
Thank you again for your help, I have one more question, what firmware option do I choose fot the gamma 602?

Hello Nick,

Happy to help, and good that you are asking first rather than after flashing.

For the Gamma 602 I do not want to guess at the right image, since picking the wrong build is exactly the mistake that bricks a board. I have passed it to JD, our hardware guy, and he will come back to you in this thread with the exact firmware option to select.

If you would rather not wait, he is on our Discord as @nullhashrate and is usually quick there. The Harlo OS channel is the right place to post it, and here is the invite: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

In the meantime, check what version the 602 is running now and have a look at the release notes on harlolabs.com, since that will tell you which path applies to your current build.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy
